title.narrative: Comprehensive Citizen Security Program
Programa Integral de Seguridad Ciudadana

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a la reduccin de los delitos violentos contra la propiedad (particularmente rapias) y contra las personas (particularmente violencia intrafamiliar y juvenil) en Uruguay. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) reducir la tasa de rapias en Montevideo; y (ii) reducir la tasa de violencia intrafamiliar (de pareja) y juvenil (por y contra jvenes) en dos barrios piloto de alta vulnerabilidad delictiva en Montevideo (Marconi y Casavalle).

The overall objective of the program is to contribute to the reduction of violent crimes against property (particularly robberies) and against persons (particularly domestic and youth violence) in Uruguay. Specific objectives are: (i) reduce the rate of robberies in Montevideo; and (ii) reduce the rate of domestic violence (partner) and youth (for and against youth) in two pilots in highly vulnerable neighborhoods in Montevideo criminal.
